purpose: Validate whether causal first-bar and frozen Entry-state features can distinguish healthy pullback from structural failure after Immediate Adverse, without fitting or tuning on the exposed 20-session diagnostic.

population.base: Frozen Minimal Hybrid v1 x MSH-Entry v1 First ENTER events
population.directionHandling: Preserve LONG/SHORT direction and report pooled plus direction split; do not retune by direction on the exposed diagnostic.

definitions.hybridScore: Frozen Minimal Hybrid score at the First ENTER decision timestamp.
definitions.hybridReciprocalRank: 1 / frozen Hybrid rank at the First ENTER decision timestamp.
definitions.mshDirectionProbability: Frozen MSH-Entry probability for the chosen LONG/SHORT direction at First ENTER.
definitions.directionalVwapDistancePct: direction * ((entryClose / causalSessionVwap) - 1) * 100 using only completed bars available at First ENTER.
definitions.relativeVolume5: Entry bar volume divided by the mean volume of the prior five completed 5m bars, matching the frozen MSH feature contract.
definitions.firstBarDirectionalCloseReturnPct: direction * ((firstCompletedPostEntryClose / entryReferencePrice) - 1) * 100. Available only after the first full 5m bar closes.
definitions.firstBarMfePct: Maximum favorable excursion within the first completed post-entry 5m bar relative to entryReferencePrice, direction adjusted and floored at zero.
definitions.firstBarMaePct: Maximum adverse excursion within the first completed post-entry 5m bar relative to entryReferencePrice, direction adjusted and capped at zero.

primaryEvaluationLabel.name: RECOVERED_BY_PLUS6_CLOSE
primaryEvaluationLabel.definition: For an Immediate Adverse trade with a complete +6-bar same-session horizon: directional gross close return at +6 bars > 0.
primaryEvaluationLabel.featureLeakageRule: The +6 label is evaluation-only and must never enter any feature, threshold, rule, or state calculation.

validationRules.minimumClaim: A feature is only a candidate discriminator until replicated on data not used for the 2026-09-11 hypothesis diagnostic.

descriptiveEvidenceOnly.warning: These values are hypothesis-generation diagnostics from 24 exposed complete +6 Immediate-Adverse trades. They are not authorized thresholds or model performance claims.
